title: Asymptotically-informed neural networks for Black-Scholes implied volatility computation
abstract: arXiv:2609.05491v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The computation of Black-Scholes implied volatility is a fundamental task in quantitative finance, underpinning option valuation, model calibration and risk management. Although implied volatility is routinely used in practice, the inversion of the Black-Scholes pricing formula remains a challenging numerical problem, particularly in asymptotic regimes corresponding to extreme option prices, strikes or maturities, where the inverse map becomes highly sensitive to perturbations of the price. In this paper, we introduce a new family of asymptotically-informed neural-network architectures for implied-volatility computation. translated_title: 面向Black-Scholes隐含波动率计算的渐近信息驱动神经网络
translated_abstract: Black-Scholes隐含波动率的计算是量化金融中的一项基础任务，支撑着期权估值、模型校准和风险管理。尽管隐含波动率在实践中被常规使用，但Black-Scholes定价公式的反演仍然是一个具有挑战性的数值问题，特别是在对应于极端期权价格、行权价或期限的渐近区域中，此时逆映射对价格的扰动变得高度敏感。在本文中，我们引入了一类新的渐近信息驱动的神经网络架构用于隐含波动率计算。利用Black-Scholes定价函数在不同波动率区域中的不同行为，我们提出了一族架构，它们通过门控函数系统学习价格-对数货币性域的可训练划分，并结合隐含波动率函数的专门化局部近似……
tldr: 本文提出一类渐近信息驱动的神经网络架构，通过门控函数系统对价格域进行可训练划分并结合专门化的局部近似，实现了Black-Scholes隐含波动的稳健高效计算，尤其适用于极端价格、行权价或期限的渐近区域。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a family of asymptotically-informed neural network architectures that learn a trainable partition of the price domain via gating functions combined with specialized local approximations, enabling robust Black-Scholes implied volatility computation even in asymptotic regimes with extreme prices, strikes, or maturities.
